description: Join multiple video or audio files in order into a single file. Uses stream copy for matching files or re-encodes when formats differ. Supports dryRun and post-flight verification.

dryRun.description: Plan-before-encode: returns planned FFmpeg command, parameters, and target output without writing files.

inputPaths.description: List of media files to concatenate in sequential order

mode.description: Concatenation mode. 'auto' (default) probes inputs to check codecs, resolutions, framerates, and audio sample rates, using fast stream copy if matching or falling back to re-encoding if they differ. 'lossless' forces stream copy. 'reencode' forces filtergraph normalization.

name: concat_media
